items.summary: Update the global BalanceIndicator so that when the signed-in user is an admin, the UI also shows the Admin Wallet Balance (in PKR) in the same fixed balance widget shown on the index/home page (and wherever BalanceIndicator is rendered), without changing the existing behavior for non-admin users.

Prevent unauthorized admin-wallet lookups from breaking the BalanceIndicator UI: the app must not surface an error state in BalanceIndicator for non-admin users due to calling the admin-wallet API; instead, it should treat admin-wallet data as unavailable and simply not render the admin-wallet portion of the UI.

Ensure the displayed Admin Wallet balance in the BalanceIndicator reflects backend state (Motoko adminWallet): after a successful admin-to-user distribution, the Admin Wallet balance shown in the UI updates without requiring a full page refresh.
